definition: The empirical curves relating accuracy to test-time compute, whether spent in parallel (more samples plus selection) or sequentially (longer chains), and the finding that a small model with search can rival a larger model without it.
details: The empirical curves relating accuracy to test-time compute, whether spent in parallel (more samples plus selection) or sequentially (longer chains), and the finding that a small model with search can rival a larger model without it.
